units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: This is Sonpur village. And this is Dadi's courtyard. Today evening there's a puja here, and Dadi is making her famous besan laddoos!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: One, two, three... eleven laddoos! Bas, that is enough for the puja.

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Aaha... what a lovely smell! Dadi, I am feeling hungry!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Just now you ate four parathas, Chhotu!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: That was my morning hunger. This is my right-now hunger!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: These laddoos are for Bhagwan-ji. Everyone gets them after puja. Till then no one will touch them. Understood?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Understood, Dadi! I will not touch at all.

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Arey, where did my glasses go? It was right here just now!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Chamki, you won't tell me either. Chalo, let me lie down a bit.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Afternoon came. Dadi fell asleep. Sheru fell asleep. And Chhotu's tummy... did not sleep at all!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Shhh, tummy-ji! Keep quiet! Dadi will wake up!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Dadi said I can't touch with hands. So I'll... use my mouth directly!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Mmm! Just one. Only just one.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Saying "just one", Chhotu completely lost count!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: This is for later. For my later-later hunger!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: No Sheru, go to sleep! You are seeing nothing at all!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Baap re! My laddoos! The plate is empty!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: What? All eleven laddoos vanished?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: What happened, Dadi? Is something the matter?

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Chhotu... what is this yellow-yellow stuff on your mouth?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: This? This is... my brand new moustache! Just like Master-ji's!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Without my glasses I can't see anything at all.

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Dadi! I saw it! A... a magical laddoo thief came here!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Magical laddoo thief?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Yes! Flying through the window, whoosh! Right onto the plate, and gulp-gulp, ate up all the laddoos!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Is it? And how did he look like?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: He... he... was totally invisible! Because he's magical, na!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: But Chhotu, the window's shut since morning!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Then he slips through closed windows also! Like the wind! Whoosh!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: And where were you that time, Chhotu?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Me? I was... sleeping with Sheru! Right, Sheru?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: See? Sheru is also saying "yes"!

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: And that's how Chhotu told his very first lie. Poor boy didn't know lies are just like laddoos—you eat one, you want another!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Friends, a magical laddoo thief is loose in Sonpur! The puja is this evening. We must catch him! Come, let's make a plan!

units.speaker: Pinky
units.text: Umm... actually, I read in a book that laddoo thieves only come on Tuesdays.

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Pinky, today is Wednesday!

units.speaker: Pinky
units.text: So... umm, actually, he must be doing overtime!

units.speaker: Bablu
units.text: Magical? Invisible? Means... a bhoot!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Bablu bhaiya, you don't even fit behind me!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: Don't fear! Raju the Great is here! Whatever thief it is, this net will catch him!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: This... this was just practice! The net is working properly!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Chhotu, you saw the thief! Tell us, what else did he look like?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Clues? Umm... he has... a bright blue tail!

units.speaker: Pinky
units.text: Bright blue tail. And?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: And he eats only round-round things! Laddoos, golgappas, balls...

units.speaker: Bablu
units.text: Balls also? My cricket ball!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: And whenever he eats, he sings a song—"Laddoo-laddoo, gappu-gappu!"

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: If he only eats round things, we'll trap him with round things! We'll bring laddoos from Lallan Chacha, keep them under the peepal tree, and hang the net above!

units.speaker: Raju
units.emotion: from inside the net, thumbs up
units.text: Super plan! But first someone get me out of this net, yaar!

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: See that? One lie made a blue tail, the tail made a song. Chhotu's lie was growing taller than the peepal tree itself!

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: Arey, my round-round babies! Don't sit in the heat, you'll burn! Come on, take a dip in the sugar syrup!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Lallan Chacha, we need four laddoos. We are setting up a trap for the magical laddoo thief!

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: What? Laddoo thief? In our village?

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: No! Nobody will touch my sweet babies! Jalebi Rani, don't be scared, your Chacha is here, na!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: Don't worry at all, Chacha. Raju the Great is here, na!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: This... this was part of the plan too! Sweet hands will attract the thief!

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: Take these four laddoos. But keep them with love. These are my best-behaved children. Never ever jump out of the kadhai!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Pakka, Chacha! As soon as we catch the thief, we'll bring them back!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Chacha, I am feeling hungry!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Chhotu! These are for the thief, not for you!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: The plan is—the thief will come eat the laddoos, I'll pull the rope, the net will drop, and thief caught!

units.speaker: Pinky
units.text: Gudiya, but the thief is invisible, na! If the net drops, how will we know if someone is inside?

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Umm... that... this part of the plan I'll make tomorrow!

units.speaker: Bablu
units.text: Listen! Nibble-nibble! The thief is here!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: Caught him! Raju the Great has caught the thief!

units.speaker: Pinky
units.text: Umm... actually, the thief's tail isn't blue, it's brown. And it barks!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Pinky, this isn't a thief, it's Sheru!

units.speaker: Bablu
units.text: Ghost! Bhoooot!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Arey children, it's me! I was searching for my glasses. Did anyone see them?

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: Kids! I have reached too! If the thief touches my jalebis, this rolling pin... this belan will teach him nicely!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Chacha, we didn't find any thief at all.

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: He... he must have gone towards Lallan Chacha's shop now! I saw his bright blue tail going that way!

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: Baap re! My jalebis are alone! I'm coming, my babies!

units.speaker: Bablu
units.text: Now I won't even be able to sleep tonight! The blue-tailed ghost will sing, "Laddoo-laddoo, gappu-gappu"...

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: And my back, yaar! Raju the Great fell three times today! This thief is too dangerous!

units.speaker: Pinky
units.text: And there are no laddoos for the puja either. Dadi is so upset. She said the puja will remain incomplete this time.

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: No problem. Tomorrow morning we'll make a new plan. We'll stay awake all night till we catch the thief!

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Chhotu's stomach was full. But now his heart was feeling very heavy. Even heavier than the laddoos.

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: No Chamki, no! That's for my later-later hunger!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Chhotu... but this is one of Dadi's laddoos!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: So the thief with the bright blue tail is...

units.speaker: Pinky
units.text: Actually... the thief has no tail, only a pocket!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Yes! I only ate all the laddoos! There's no magical thief! No blue tail, no song! I was hungry, then got scared, then kept lying and lying... Sorry! I'm sorry to everyone!

units.speaker: Bablu
units.text: Means... there is no ghost at all?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: No, Bablu bhaiya. No ghost. Only me.

units.speaker: Bablu
units.text: Uff! Thank you, Chhotu! Now I can sleep peacefully!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Dadi, I ate the laddoos. And then I lied. I'm sorry.

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: I knew it all along, Chhotu.

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: You already knew? But your glasses...

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: I didn't have glasses, but I had my nose! Your mouth smelled of yummy besan. I was just waiting for you to tell the truth yourself.

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: I will never lie again, Dadi. Lying is too tiring, yaar!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Chalo, let's all make fresh laddoos together now. There's still time for the puja!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: Means I don't have to trip over the net anymore?

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: No Raju, now you just put your hands in the besan!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Come, let's make a plan! A plan for making laddoos! This time there will be no holes in the plan!

units.speaker: Pinky
units.text: Actually, Gudiya, every plan of yours has a hole in it!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Then this time we will fill the hole with besan!

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: And so began Sonpur's most fun laddoo factory ever!

units.speaker: Pinky
units.text: Actually, laddoos should be made square. They last much longer!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Pinky bitiya, laddoos look best when round. Roll them round and round, like this!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: Look, Raju the Great's super laddoo! The biggest one!

units.speaker: Raju
units.text: This... this is a crushed laddoo! Brand new design!

units.speaker: Bablu
units.text: My laddoos have turned out totally round!

units.speaker: Bablu
units.text: Ghost! A ghost took my laddoo away!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Bablu, that is Chamki!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Tummy-ji, these are puja laddoos. Have some patience!

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Wah Chhotu! Today you have really become a big boy!

units.speaker: Lallan
units.text: My jalebis are safe and sound! The thief never came! In joy, these jalebis for the puja are on me!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Now prasad for everyone. And the first laddoo... to Chhotu, who told the truth.

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: The lie laddoo felt heavy in my tummy. But the truth laddoo is so light and sweet-sweet!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: One who speaks the truth always has a heart as sweet as a laddoo.

units.speaker: Gudiya
units.text: Look, Sheru woke up! At eating time he always wakes up!

units.speaker: Dadi
units.text: Arey, where did my glasses vanish again?

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Dadi, the magical glasses thief took it!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: No-no, I'll speak the truth—it's right on top of your head!

units.speaker: Chhotu
units.text: Now I'm really, really hungry, yaar!
